scripts.dev: cd artifacts/solana-explorer && PORT=${PORT:-8080} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} vite --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.start: cd artifacts/solana-explorer && PORT=${PORT:-8080} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} vite preview --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
